description: Example showing how to use python-tuf ngclient to perform a TUF update
code:
from tuf.ngclient import Updater

# Initialize the TUF updater with repository URL and local metadata path
updater = Updater(
    metadata_dir='/path/to/local/tuf/metadata',
    metadata_base_url='https://my-tuf-repository.example.com/metadata/',
    target_base_url='https://my-tuf-repository.example.com/targets/',
    target_dir='/path/to/download/directory'
)

# Refresh all metadata (root, targets, snapshot, timestamp)
updater.refresh()

# Find a specific target file
target_info = updater.get_targetinfo('myapp-1.2.3-linux-amd64.tar.gz')

if target_info is not None:
    # Download and verify the target
    path = updater.find_cached_target(target_info)
    if path is None:
        path = updater.download_target(target_info)
    print(f'Target downloaded to: {path}')
else:
    print('Target not found in repository')
notes: The TUF ngclient automatically verifies all metadata signatures, checks expiration, and validates file hashes before completing the download.
